name: listenarr
description: Listenarr - Automated audiobook downloading and management

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "wait-on http-get://localhost:4545/api/v1/system/health -t 120000 -i 1000 --httpTimeout 3000 && cd fe && npm run dev" --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "blue,green"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:backend:check && npm run format:frontend:check
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
